implemented_requirements.evidence: FileReader.read in file_reader.py reads a file with multiple encodings and raises clear errors.
PalindromeDetector.detect_words iterates over WORD_PATTERN matches, uses is_palindrome and creates PalindromeMatch objects.
PalindromeDetector.detect_sentences iterates over SENTENCE_PATTERN matches, applies is_palindrome and records matches.
main.py defines parse_arguments and run, wiring FileReader, PalindromeDetector, and ReportGenerator together.
ReportGenerator.format_report builds a formatted string; print_report outputs it to stdout.
ReportGenerator.save_report writes the report to a path when the --output argument is supplied.

judge.summary: The provided code implements a full palindrome‑detection program. It can read a text file, detect palindromic words or sentences according to configurable options, and produce a formatted report that can be printed or saved. All core functionalities are present and appear executable, with no stubbed or missing components.
